verdict.rationale: Reflect's AI palette (cmd+j on highlighted text) accepts free-form natural-language prompts, which can be saved as custom prompts, and users can "chat" with filtered notes to ask questions and extract information. These cover NL-driven text transformation and querying, but nothing shows NL commands driving app actions such as creating, tagging, linking or organizing notes. Missing for 10: natural-language control of app operations beyond text editing and Q&A, an agentic command interface, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
